model: early-warning GRU ensemble (ONNX), realistic p75 target

trend.source: cases grouped by the month their realistic target window ended (still-open cases count as breached), Wilson 95% interval
trend.note: Cases are grouped by deadline month, not completion month, so the series is not biased towards fast cases. Months with fewer than 30 cases are omitted.

already_late.note: Open cases already older than their realistic target: breach is determined, not predicted.

at_risk_open.note: Open cases with P(breach) >= 0.3. Early-warning model: weak signal, see /v1/models.

unscored_open.note: Fewer than 2 events seen so far; no early-warning score yet.

value_flagged_eur.note: Order value seen so far on already-late and at-risk open cases.

expected_loss_eur.source: p x value x breach cost share

assumption.note: Assumed cost of a breach as a share of order value; no cost-of-delay data exists in the log.

breach_rate_realistic_30d.source: cases whose target window ended in the 30 days before as_of
breach_rate_realistic_30d.note: Share of cases that ended after their realistic target (still-open cases count as breached). Not biased by fast cases closing first. Null when n < 30.

breach_rate_configured_all_closed.note: Secondary only: 86% of cases fall back to a 240 h target; not a realistic service level.

ap_exceptions.source: AP controls over the whole log (not clocked)

interventions_recorded.note: No real interventions recorded; ROI is simulated.

snapshot.source: local event log, same build functions as the live API
